lesson dev-orientation, beat 1/5 · speaker Detective Reyes · goal: Your desk.

source: Welcome to your desk. I'll show you where everything is, then leave you to work.
text: 欢迎来到查询控制台。我带你看一圈东西都在哪儿，然后你自己干。
note: lesson dev-orientation, beat 1/5 · speaker Detective Reyes · goal: Your desk.

source: The query goes in the query desk.
You write the query here. It is SQL, and it is read-only. `SELECT`, nothing else.
text: 你在这里写查询。这是SQL，而且只读。除了`SELECT`，没别的。
note: lesson dev-orientation, beat 2/5 · goal: The query goes in the query desk.

source: Run executes the query. Run it as many times as you like. The rows come back underneath.
text: “运行”把查询跑一遍。想跑多少次都行。查出来的行显示在下面。
note: lesson dev-orientation, beat 3/5 · difficulty 1 · goal: Run executes the query.

source: Verify sends those rows in as your answer. It reads the rows you brought back and nothing else.
text: “核实”把这些行作为答案交上去。它只看你查出来的行，别的都不看。
note: lesson dev-orientation, beat 4/5 · difficulty 1 · goal: Verify submits your answer.

source: The card lists every clause the game asks for, and the tables. That is everything.
text: 速查卡上列着游戏要用的每个子句，还有各个表。就这些。
note: lesson dev-orientation, beat 5/5 · goal: The card lists every clause.
